study: UEFA Nations League independent senior international Elo reference; retrospective comparisons, no automatic promotion

rating.update: Both sides use start-of-local-recorded-day ratings; apply summed zero-sum updates after the whole source date. W/D/L uses source score, which can include extra time. Friendlies weighted identically. No goal-margin multiplier, market, UEFA model or paywalled rating.

goal_model: Poisson on each side jointly, predictors intercept, signed home advantage (zero on neutral), signed pregame Elo gap / 400, each coefficient learned on earlier UEFA league-phase results. Baseline fits intercept and signed home advantage alone. No hyperparameter search; maximum-likelihood fits. Use joint mode, marginal W/D/L, P(total>=3) threshold .5 for standardized over 2.5.

evaluation.eligible: all verified 2024 league-phase events in repaired SQLite
evaluation.ratings_snapshot: 2024-07-29 (last result July 14), frozen for all targets
evaluation.fit: 2018/20/22 group matches, outcome verified in both ESPN and as-of world snapshot

evaluation.eligible: all 52 first issues ledger (independent same-match source original Current/Test and matrix-derived totals when no original total pick)
evaluation.ratings_snapshot: 2026-10-31 (last result Oct 6), frozen for all targets
evaluation.fit: 2018/20/22/24 group matches, outcome verified in both ESPN and as-of world snapshot

forward_rule: Only known, senior men, league-phase, named scheduled fixtures in ESPN publication window; playoffs require a separate model scope.
result_integrity: Two-source final score disagreement or contemporary event commentary marking an abandonment excludes that match from calibration, evaluation and post-event Elo updates; retain exclusions with raw evidence.
calibration_scope: Separate fit for each of A, B, C and D league-phase, shared fixed Elo update recipe across international opponents.
